Base_Editing_ABE.bystander_editing_risk: High if multiple As in 4-8nt window
Base_Editing_ABE.edit_scope: A->G transitions only (approx 28% of pathogenic point mutations)

Base_Editing_CBE.mmr_sensitivity: Low to Moderate (Uracil glycosylase can excise, inhibited by UGI)
Base_Editing_CBE.edit_scope: C->T transitions only (approx 32% of pathogenic point mutations)

Prime_Editing_PEmax.edit_scope: All 12 base conversions, insertions up to 100bp, deletions (approx 89% of known genetic diseases)

diligence_recommendation.verdict: ALLOCATE BY CLINICAL DELIVERY ROUTE & MUTATION TYPE
diligence_recommendation.in_vivo_cns_recommendation: Base Editing (SaCas9-ABE8e) preferred for CNS where single AAV9 capsid is mandatory and target is a clean transition.
diligence_recommendation.in_vivo_hepatic_recommendation: Prime Editing via LNP mRNA delivery preferred for transversions/insertions where liver ApoE targeting provides high biodistribution.
diligence_recommendation.ex_vivo_hspc_recommendation: Base editing yields higher editing fraction (48% vs 14.5%) unless PEmax is co-delivered with transient MLH1dn peptide.
